user_review.method: Port and review the author-owned open PR #1 into the authoritative registry. Execute offline fixture tests through the actual poster and YouTube reader/exporter; no live private playlist or OAuth request.

scenarios.request: Compare a saved playlist containing one recording with an intended twelve-track mix.
scenarios.expected: Report mismatch and eleven missing recordings, not a completed save.
scenarios.observed: Executable comparison fixture returned mismatch, expectedCount 12, actualCount 1 and eleven missing IDs.

scenarios.request: A source service accepts only one track, or a destination read lacks permission, pages or a stable count.
scenarios.expected: Keep the result incomplete/blocked; never turn it into success.
scenarios.observed: Stubbed service acceptance of 1/12 was rejected; missing auth, incomplete positions, changed totals and repeated page tokens were rejected. Full acceptance remained ready-to-import, with destination unverified.

scenarios.request: Export exact URLs twice to the same output file.
scenarios.expected: Preserve the first export rather than overwrite it.
scenarios.observed: First CLI export wrote twelve URLs; second returned blocked and retained identical bytes.

similar_skills.learned: Read-only library inspection must cover all pages and stable recording identifiers.
similar_skills.reason: Apply complete ordered ID comparison to YouTube. Reject session-token extraction and personal setup paths; keep authorized runtime OAuth only.

similar_skills.learned: Report attempted, found and missing tracks separately and retain the existing playlist identity.
similar_skills.reason: Keep counts and missing recordings explicit. Do not adopt automatic write retries, destructive replacement, or unrelated Spotify setup.

similar_skills.learned: Title and artist matching with explicit alternate-version treatment makes a useful source match.
similar_skills.reason: Preserve existing catalog matching but independently verify destination IDs; a create/add response alone is insufficient.

validation.observed: 23 offline tests passed; provider responses mocked, no paid generation or private-library mutation.

user_review.method: Same-session maintainer walkthrough of changed public copy against the existing capability and examples. Simulated reader cases; no independent user trial or live market-performance claim. Prior runtime evidence is preserved separately.

scenarios.request: Make a mood playlist and prefer the original studio recordings.
scenarios.expected: The page offers Apple storefront checks and a separately reported import result.
scenarios.observed: The page offers Apple storefront checks and a separately reported import result.

scenarios.request: Did the Apple check prove the Spotify library now contains the exact versions?
scenarios.expected: Keep the capability or evidence boundary visible.
scenarios.observed: The added version guidance explicitly keeps destination status pending and links provider recovery guidance.

similar_skills.learned: Separate search intent and map the task to a relevant page.
similar_skills.reason: Use function/problem/pain observations to clarify this page; reject invented volume and keyword stuffing.

similar_skills.learned: Give one intended reader a useful answer supported by evidence.
similar_skills.reason: Lead with a concrete task and honest outcome; keep existing examples and evidence limits.

user_review.method: Maintainer new-user walkthrough, live read-only Apple catalog verification, local poster dry run, and offline failure tests. No Soundiiz post or destination-library write.

scenarios.request: Make five after-hours electronic tracks for YouTube Music with a named opener and the US storefront.
scenarios.expected: Return a coherent ordered list, a catalog receipt and a separately qualified handoff status.
scenarios.observed: Confirmed all five catalog entries with zero unconfirmed. Poster dry run accepted ytmusic and plural artists. README shows the five songs and records destination import as untested.

scenarios.request: A song title changes after catalog verification.
scenarios.expected: Reject before posting and tell the user how to recover.
scenarios.observed: The real poster dry run refused the edited canonical sample with the rerun-canonicalize message. No request was sent.

scenarios.request: The import link is unavailable or a destination receipt has not arrived.
scenarios.expected: Supply an ordered copyable fallback and keep the destination pending.
scenarios.observed: Instruction walkthrough yields Artist - Title lines and manual import steps. Catalog success remains visible, while the link stays unavailable and the destination awaits proof.

similar_skills.learned: An outcome visible on the first screen gives a visitor a concrete reason to continue.
similar_skills.reason: Show a five-song result, order, and independent verification stages near the top.

similar_skills.learned: The workflow makes intermediate matching and playlist publication distinct.
similar_skills.reason: Translate that separation to catalog, link, and destination receipts while keeping Mixtape's existing user confirmation.

similar_skills.learned: Catalog lookup prefers a matching title and artist but can fall back to its first result.
similar_skills.reason: Keep strict recording identity and avoid browser-session credentials or a weak fallback that could silently substitute a different track.

similar_skills.learned: Plain-text input accepts Artist - Title lines; the destination match is a later step.
similar_skills.reason: Make the copyable fallback actionable and distinguish import preparation from a destination receipt.
